validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <final id="a">
    <donedata>
      <content expr="1"/>
      <param name="p" expr="2"/>
    </donedata>
  </final>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: donedata cannot contain both `content` and `param` children
notes: done data is either one `<content>` value or a set of `<param>` name/value pairs
diagnostics.help: return either one content value or parameter children: remove the `<content>` to return the parameters, or the `<param>` children to return the content
